title: Tighten WebView UI cohesion boundaries
summary: Implements the UI cohesion remediation plan for Library route ownership, accessible route controls, final-library promotion wording, topbar readiness buttons, status semantics, evidence-tools labeling, and focused smoke/static tests.
reason: The operator requested execution of all findings from the latest UI cohesion review without changing backend media-policy semantics.
behavior_before: Library route UI could fall back to frontend-authored route defaults and a nested custom slider, final-library promotion copy used queue-oriented labels, topbar readiness spans were clickable text, and repeated evidence tables/panels had uneven accessibility semantics.
behavior_after: Library route readouts are sourced from backend metadata/current config with advisory missing-data text, route boundaries use accessible numeric controls and a read-only rail, final-library promotion copy uses the reviewed-output canonical label with overwrite/cleanup disclosure, topbar readiness controls are semantic buttons, canonical status states remain distinct, and proof/evidence tables/panels expose accessible names and evidence-tools labeling.
